question.text: Two coils require <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math> minutes and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn></math> minutes respectively to produce same amount of heat energy when connected separately to the same source. If they are connected in parallel arrangement to the same source; the time required to produce same amount of heat by the combination of coils, will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>min</mi></math>.

solution.text:
If H is the heat required to heat the water, then

P1×60=H⇒P1=H60 and P2×20=H⇒P2=H20

When the coils are connected in parallel their powers will get added. If the required time now is t, then

P1+P2t=H⇒t=HH60+H20=15 min
